title: Separate untrusted and privileged Chromium profiles on the host
description:
Purpose: kernel Gherkin (browser_context_policy.feature) already separates untrusted vs privileged contexts. Remaining 4ddbe1 DoD: live Chromium on the computer host must not spend privileged cookies or ambient workspace secrets from an untrusted browse.

Acceptance:
- Untrusted browse uses a distinct Chromium user-data/profile from privileged sessions; cookies and storage do not cross.
- Untrusted context cannot read workspace secret paths (e.g. /workspace/.env) via the browser.
- Generic authenticated browser_open without a bound privileged session stops at the existing sink (no cookie jar reuse).
- Kernel Gherkin stays the authority; host executor implements it. desiredCount 0. No cdk deploy --all, no production, no 35d86b / PR #26.
- snapshot_cookie_integrity remains a v1 exclusion (do not pretend relocate sanitizes cookies).
